clips.title: The story
paras: The Highborne, or quel'dorei, were the aristocratic sorcerer caste of the ancient Kaldorei Empire who served Queen Azshara. Their reckless manipulation of the Well of Eternity brought the Burning Legion to Azeroth, leading to the devastating War of the Ancients and the Great Sundering.

Before the Sundering, the Highborne arose as the favored upper class surrounding Queen Azshara. Claiming superiority over common kaldorei through selective bloodlines, intelligence, and opulent privilege, they strictly controlled access to the Well of Eternity. They discovered how to tap and shape its primal arcane energies, erecting magnificent cities across ancient Kalimdor. Their endless thirst for greater sorcery led them to draw deeper from the Well, turning its calm waters turbulent and dark.
